title: Meals You Can't Miss
editorial: Feijoada is mandatory if you eat meat. Our first bowl near Copacabana was rich, cheap and excellent.
In Manaus, try tambaqui and other Amazonian fish. Acai also comes from this region, which made us realise we had mentally filed it under “East Asian trendy thing” for no defensible reason.
Brazil's regional scale means food changes drastically as you move. Treat every flight as permission to reset the menu.
